_comment: All optional. Copy to ~/.clauled.json only if you need one of these.
_port: Override device auto-detection. Normally unnecessary - the device is found by its Espressif vendor ID (303A) on every platform.
_port_note: On macOS always use the cu.* node, never tty.* - opening a tty.* device blocks until carrier is asserted.
_debug: Capture raw statusline and hook payloads to ~/.clauled-debug.log. Contains prompts and file paths; check before sharing.
_token: Optional fallback for the 5h gauge. Normally NOT needed - Claude Code sends rate_limits in the statusline payload, which is used automatically. Only set this if that gauge never populates. From 'claude setup-token'.
_token_permissions: If you set it, chmod 600 ~/.clauled.json - it is a real credential valid for a year.
_quiet: Local hours (0-23) during which the device powers its panel off after being idle. Requires Clauled firmware v3.5.0. quietEnd is exclusive; quietEnd <= quietStart wraps past midnight (e.g. 23 and 7 for 11pm-7am).
